wirral_paddock_keeper.text: Thornlea. We board breeding stock for people whose own fields have run out of field. Six at a time, no more, and the gate stays shut.
Keep the troughs and the carrot bucket stocked and the place pays its way. Mostly. The fox has opinions.

wirral_paddock_vet.text: Half my job is telling people the limp is a stone. The other half is being right about it.
Keep an eye on how closely your stock are related. Cousins are fine; brothers and sisters are asking for trouble, and the farmer will say so.
